The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by the patients (e.g., Insurance Card). This screen can be accessed by clicking the ‘CScan’ button from the OP service billing screen. Mandatory fields are indicated in red, and one of the fields is 'Fileno' for entering a file number. You can view an image related to the CScan service here: ![CScan Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114335.png).
